title: Forbidden Books: Censorship of Children's & Young Adult Literature
department: Teaching and Learning, Policy and Leadership
description: Critically examines the history of censorship from Plato to the Patriot Act with a focus on contemporary censorship analyzed through historical, political, ethical, moral, philosophical, and socio-cultural perspectives. The course examines the evolving definition of censorship, the common elements found in all forms of censorship, the rationalizations and arguments for censorship, and the consequences and unintended results of censorship.
